reuse.why: Adds shared predicates (skipsWeekendDays, isSkippedWeekendDay, DAILY_WEEKEND_SCAN_LENGTH) and keeps using getDateWithSkippedWeekend, but getNextDate's findNextOccurrence re-checks d.isWeekend instead of using isSkippedWeekendDay, and schedule-template gets a private getWeekendMovedDay instead of a shared move-or-skip helper.

duplication.why: The 'scan extra occurrences, drop skipped weekend days, keep the first N' step is written twice (findNextOccurrence and getUpcomingDates), and the 'skipWeekend ? getDateWithSkippedWeekend : date' move decision remains inline in getNextDate and getUpcomingDates beside the new local getWeekendMovedDay.

placement.why: The skip predicates sit in shared/schedules.ts as they should, but the move-unless-daily rule (getWeekendMovedDay) is placed privately in server/budget/schedule-template.ts rather than next to getDateWithSkippedWeekend where the other callers could use it.

scope.why: Focused on the daily-weekend rule; the isBoundedSchedule change to getNextDate's last-occurrence fallback is an extra behavioural tweak beyond the request.

maintainability.why: A maintainer has a named predicate to change, but the skip-vs-move outcome is assembled differently at each of the three consumers, so the rule is easy to change in one and miss in another.

bypasses_abstraction.where: findNextOccurrence in shared/schedules.ts tests skipWeekendDays && d.isWeekend directly instead of isSkippedWeekendDay; getNextDate and getUpcomingDates (server/schedules/app.ts) keep their own inline move ternary while schedule-template.ts defines its own getWeekendMovedDay.

disguised_duplication.where: The over-fetch-and-filter of weekend occurrences appears as .find in findNextOccurrence (shared/schedules.ts) and as .filter(...).slice(0, count) in getUpcomingDates (server/schedules/app.ts).

one_place.where: Only the predicate is shared (skipsWeekendDays/isSkippedWeekendDay in shared/schedules.ts); whether a daily weekend occurrence is skipped or moved is applied separately in getNextDate (findNextOccurrence + inline move), getUpcomingDates (filter + inline move) and schedule-template (isSkippedWeekendDay + local getWeekendMovedDay).
